title: Corentin Bernadou: giant initials, a 3D image cube and a project name column
note: Black page with a pixel ruler on the edges, 'FW' in huge orange (#ff4d00) grotesk, small meta 'Corentin Bernadou / Freelance Developer / Issue N°003 / Coll. 2026 / Ref…' like a magazine colophon, a 3D cube of project images that turns as you scroll, and a long scrolling list of project names on the right. Worth noting as a creative-developer pattern, but it's the kind of 'too much motion, what am I looking at' Petra wants to move away from. The colophon-style meta is the part worth keeping.
